user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 720 lux
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() < 720 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_up() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF wotie_brightness_sensor.brightness() > 720 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN brightness_down() wotie_brightness_sensor
IF viomi_hood.reading() >= 0.63 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN power_on() viomi_hood
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN power_off() viomi_hood
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN light_off() wotie_brightness_sensor
